results.releaseNotes:
Two ways to start.

Focus Music now opens with a choice. Guided sets the session up for you: name what you are working on, pick a length, and we will start you on the right channel. Free Flow hands you the controls: browse everything and drive it yourself.

What else is new:

Sessions that remember you. Save a session and it comes back ready to go, same channel, same task, fresh timer. Your recent sessions and channels are waiting on the home screen.

A better way to browse. A redesigned channel browser with search, organised by family, so you can find the right sound in seconds.

Steer without stopping. Ask for more like this, a different vibe, or a change of energy, and the music adjusts while it keeps playing.

No more passwords. Sign in with a code we email you. Starting a free trial is password free too.

Music starts when you say so. Opening the app no longer starts playing on its own.

A fresh look. New colors throughout, a new home screen, and a cleaner player.

Smoother playback. More reliable resume when you come back, better transitions between tracks, and accurate session timing.

Plus a long list of fixes across sign in, billing and playback.
results.description:
Ever sit down to work, only to find yourself distracted before you've even started?

If you struggle with distractions, have ADHD, or find it difficult to get started, you're not alone.

focus.music combines scientifically designed music with an adaptive system that helps you settle into work faster and stay focused longer.

Start a session and begin.

GUIDED OR MANUAL. YOU CHOOSE.

There isn't one right way to use focus.music.

Choose Guided Mode if you'd like focus.music to recommend focus environments based on your sessions.

Choose Manual Mode if you already know what works best for you and want to browse and choose your own focus environment.

Switch between them whenever you like.

FOCUS SESSIONS, NOT PLAYLISTS

This is not a playlist app.

It is a focus environment designed for real work.

Set a 25-minute, 50-minute, custom, or free-flow session. Name your task. Press play. Let the music support the work instead of competing for your attention.

HUMAN  MUSIC

Every track is composed and performed by professional musicians.

No AI-generated audio.

No vocals competing for your attention.

No endless playlists to sort through.

Just carefully crafted focus environments designed to help you stay in the zone.

A SYSTEM THAT LEARNS WITH YOU

The more you use focus.music, the better it understands what helps you stay engaged.

It learns from the sessions you complete and gradually makes better recommendations, while always leaving you in control.

BUILT ON 16 YEARS OF RESEARCH

focus.music combines more than 16 years of research into music, attention, and cognitive performance with behavioral data gathered across millions of real focus sessions.

Our goal is simple.

Help you spend less time trying to focus and more time doing meaningful work.

BUILT FOR REAL WORK

Use focus.music for:

- Deep work
- Writing
- Studying
- Coding
- Planning
- Creative work
- Reading
- Research
- Admin tasks
- Any task where staying focused matters

TRY IT FREE

Start with a 7-day free trial and experience the difference for yourself.

Make your hours count.

SUBSCRIPTION - FOCUS.MUSIC FULL ACCESS

A focus.music subscription unlocks every focus environment and energy level, unlimited focus sessions, full timer control with 25-minute, 50-minute, custom, and free-flow sessions, plus uninterrupted playback.

- Monthly: $4.99 per month
- Annual: $39.99 per year (save 33%)
- 7-day free trial with full access - no charge during the trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
- Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the rate of your selected plan
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription
- We'll remind you by email before your trial ends. Cancel anytime in two clicks.
